title: RDP open to the Internet
recommendation: Restrict TCP/3389 to approved admin sources or remove direct exposure.

title: SSH exposed from Internet
recommendation: Remove public TCP/22 or use a controlled administration path.

title: Public blob access enabled
recommendation: Disable anonymous public blob access unless explicitly required.

title: Purge protection disabled
recommendation: Enable purge protection for stronger recovery against destructive changes.

title: Management path lacks Just-In-Time controls
recommendation: Use restricted administration and time-bound access controls.
